children: Sharma, who took over as chairman in January 2021, purchased the shares at an average price of 6.88p each, for a total value of £10,007.24.
Following the transaction, Sharma now holds a beneficial interest in 1.72m ordinary Kromek shares, representing approximately 0.3% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1535 BST, Kromek shares were down 0.44% at 6.85p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
